sequential.description: Sequential 4-byte element access, one float per thread

column_major.description: Column-0 read from a row-major 32x32 float tile (stride = 32 elements = 128 bytes)

padded_column.description: Column-0 read from a row-major 32x33 padded float tile (stride = 33 elements = 132 bytes)

stride_7.description: Strided access with 7-element stride (28 bytes per step)

broadcast_groups.description: Grouped broadcast pattern with 4-8 threads per group sharing addresses, groups mapping to overlapping banks

quadratic_scatter.description: Nonlinear scatter pattern using quadratic index mapping with modular arithmetic
